content: Progressive enhancement: keep <form method='post' action='/x' hx-post='/x'>; without JS the browser posts natively, with htmx present htmx intercepts and posts via XHR. Same pattern hx-boost relies on. Server distinguishes the two by the HX-Request header: HX-Request present -> return a fragment; absent -> return the classic 302 redirect. This dual-return is the core server-side cost of PE.
